profile.brief: the Sweden brief, applied to Norway (sources swapped for the Norwegian equivalents)
profile.laser_line: Høydedata, project "Follo 2014" (id 119, FKB-Laser 2.0, nominal 5 points/m², supplier Blom Geomatics), © Kartverket, CC BY 4.0, exported from hoydedata.no as LAZ (EPSG:25832, NN2000) clipped to the station box
profile.box_note: : the hoydedata.no export rectangle (platforms plus a margin)
profile.dtm_what: Ground, 1 m, float32, EPSG:25832, NN2000, gridded here from the laser's ground points (class 2), median per 1 m cell; cells with no ground point (under buildings, trains, roofs) are no-data
profile.dtm_licence: Høydedata, project "Follo 2014" (id 119, FKB-Laser 2.0, nominal 5 points/m², supplier Blom Geomatics), © Kartverket, CC BY 4.0, exported from hoydedata.no as LAZ (EPSG:25832, NN2000) clipped to the station box
profile.ground_how: ground grid from the laser class 2 (see the GeoTIFF tags)
profile.register_what: Bane NOR Sportabell platforms (track, length, height in mm, width, type) placed on the OSM track centreline, with the laser levels
profile.register_licence: facts from Bane NOR's station page (not open: facts only); line geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; NSR quays © Entur, NLOD
profile.register_text: Register: Bane NOR station page, track table (https://www.banenor.no/en/traffic-and-travel/railway-stations/-s-/ski/, read 2026-10-30): per track the platform length, height (mm above top of rail), width and type; no coordinates, so each platform is drawn on the OSM track centreline (see `x_geometry` per feature). Heights are Bane NOR's per-platform values, not classes.
profile.osm_warning: The laser data is © Kartverket, CC BY 4.0: do not upload values derived from it to OpenStreetMap without Kartverket's permission for OSM.
